_about: Providers & Accounts rows. `per` rows are drawn inside each account or service; their Details panel lists what each one has. Key rows live with their own service and route there.

ai.accounts.account-name.label: Account nickname
ai.accounts.account-name.perWhere: Open an account under AI & Providers › Providers & Accounts › Services.
ai.accounts.account-name.why: Tell two accounts of the same service apart, like Work and Personal.

ai.accounts.account-enabled.label: Use this account
ai.accounts.account-enabled.perWhere: Open an account under AI & Providers › Providers & Accounts › Services.
ai.accounts.account-enabled.why: Keep an account signed in but out of the way, for example while its plan is paused.

ai.accounts.account-roles.label: Jobs an account may do
ai.accounts.account-roles.perWhere: Open an account under AI & Providers › Providers & Accounts › Services.
ai.accounts.account-roles.why: Keep an expensive account for the hardest jobs, or a small one for everyday work. None picked means any job.

ai.accounts.billing-entity.label: Who is billed for an account
ai.accounts.billing-entity.perWhere: Open an account under AI & Providers › Providers & Accounts › Services.
ai.accounts.billing-entity.why: The Usage page groups costs by it, so a team account and a personal one stay apart.

ai.accounts.claude-login-method.label: How a Claude account signs in
ai.accounts.claude-login-method.perWhere: Open an account under AI & Providers › Providers & Accounts › Services.
ai.accounts.claude-login-method.why: Your company uses single sign-on, or you sign in with an email link instead of the Claude website.

ai.accounts.codex-auth-family.label: ChatGPT plan or OpenAI API key
ai.accounts.codex-auth-family.perWhere: Open an account under AI & Providers › Providers & Accounts › Services.
ai.accounts.codex-auth-family.note: Each account is one or the other, set when it is added. They are billed separately, so add each one you use as its own account.

ai.accounts.gcp-project-id.label: Google Cloud project
ai.accounts.gcp-project-id.perWhere: Open a Gemini API or Vertex AI account under Providers & Accounts › Services.
ai.accounts.gcp-project-id.why: Vertex AI always needs one. The Gemini API needs one only on paid tiers.

ai.accounts.account-priority.label: Account order
ai.accounts.account-priority.perWhere: Change the order with the arrows next to each account under Services.
ai.accounts.account-priority.why: The first account in use is tried first; the next takes over when it runs out.

ai.accounts.account-threshold-override.label: An account's own switch point
ai.accounts.account-threshold-override.perWhere: Open an account under AI & Providers › Providers & Accounts › Services.
ai.accounts.account-threshold-override.why: A small trial account should hand over earlier than your main one.

ai.accounts.switch-mode-override.label: How an account shares work
ai.accounts.switch-mode-override.perWhere: Open an account under AI & Providers › Providers & Accounts › Services.

ai.accounts.cooldown-policy.label: Rest after a rate limit
ai.accounts.cooldown-policy.perWhere: Open an account under AI & Providers › Providers & Accounts › Services.

ai.accounts.retry-budget.label: Retries before an account rests
ai.accounts.retry-budget.perWhere: Open an account under AI & Providers › Providers & Accounts › Services.

ai.accounts.quota-profile.label: Quota profile
ai.accounts.quota-profile.perWhere: Open an account under AI & Providers › Providers & Accounts › Services.

ai.accounts.auth-family.label: Account type
ai.accounts.auth-family.perWhere: Open an account under AI & Providers › Providers & Accounts › Services.

ai.accounts.credential-storage.label: Where an account's key is kept
ai.accounts.credential-storage.perWhere: Open an account under AI & Providers › Providers & Accounts › Services.

ai.accounts.auth-surface.label: How an account's key is sent
ai.accounts.auth-surface.perWhere: Open an account under AI & Providers › Providers & Accounts › Services.

ai.accounts.set-preferred-account.label: Use an account for the next run
ai.accounts.set-preferred-account.actionLabel: Use an account for the next run
routeToast: Use for the next run is at the bottom of each account.

ai.models.provider-enabled.label: Use a service
ai.models.provider-enabled.perWhere: Open a service under AI & Providers › Providers & Accounts › Services.
ai.models.provider-enabled.perEmpty: No service is set up yet

ai.accounts.auth-mode.label: Preferred way to sign in
ai.accounts.auth-mode.perWhere: In a service's More options, for services with more than one way to sign in.

ai.accounts.anthropic-api-key.label: Anthropic API key
ai.accounts.anthropic-api-key.note: Keys are typed only in the service's own key dialog. They are kept in your server's keychain and never shown, exported or copied into settings.

ai.accounts.openai-api-key.label: ChatGPT / Codex key
ai.accounts.openai-api-key.note: Keys are typed only in the service's own key dialog. They are kept in your server's keychain and never shown, exported or copied into settings.

ai.accounts.gemini-api-key.label: Gemini API key
ai.accounts.gemini-api-key.note: Keys are typed only in the service's own key dialog. They are kept in your server's keychain and never shown, exported or copied into settings.

ai.accounts.cursor-api-key.label: Cursor key
ai.accounts.cursor-api-key.note: Keys are typed only in the service's own key dialog. They are kept in your server's keychain and never shown, exported or copied into settings.

ai.accounts.minimax-api-key.label: MiniMax Coding Plan key
ai.accounts.minimax-api-key.note: Keys are typed only in the service's own key dialog. They are kept in your server's keychain and never shown, exported or copied into settings.

ai.accounts.provider-connections.label: Your AI services
ai.accounts.provider-connections.why: Connect, re-check or disconnect a service from its own page in the list.

system.advanced.cli-path-cursor.label: Cursor app location
system.advanced.cli-path-cursor.help: Only if you also use the Cursor app on your server.

ai.accounts.opencode-server-auth.label: Server password
ai.accounts.opencode-server-auth.help: Only if the server asks for one. Separate from any model keys inside OpenCode.

ai.accounts.opencode-cli-path.label: OpenCode program location
ai.accounts.opencode-cli-path.help: Only used when the server cannot be reached directly.

ai.accounts.opencode-disable-cc-skills.label: Skip Claude Code skills in OpenCode

ai.usage.free-models-auto-apply.label: Add newly free models by themselves

ai.models.default-provider.label: Service tried first
ai.models.default-provider.why: You pay for one service and want it used before the others.
ai.models.default-provider.help: Used first when more than one service could do a job.

ai.models.default-model.label: Everyday model
ai.models.default-model.help: For chat, planning and research when nothing more specific is chosen.

ai.models.default-variant.label: Speed or power
ai.models.default-variant.help: Faster and cheaper, or slower and smarter, without changing the model.

ai.models.reasoning-effort.label: Thinking depth
ai.models.reasoning-effort.help: Deeper is smarter but slower and costs more.

general.interaction.provider-disclosure.label: Say when a different model answered
general.interaction.provider-disclosure.help: Nothing swaps without you seeing it.

ai.usage.auto-refresh-discovery.label: Check for new models at startup
ai.usage.auto-refresh-discovery.help: New and retired models show up without a manual refresh.

ai.models.overseer-model.label: Planning and supervising
ai.models.overseer-model.help: Turns plans into work and supervises runs.

ai.models.worker-model.label: Everyday building
ai.models.worker-model.help: The day-to-day building. A mid-range model keeps costs down.

ai.models.gui-worker-model.label: Design and layout
ai.models.gui-worker-model.help: Screens, layout and look. Pick one with good taste.

ai.models.high-effort-worker-model.label: The hardest jobs
ai.models.high-effort-worker-model.help: Big changes across the project and risky reasoning.

ai.models.auditor-model.label: Checking finished work
ai.models.auditor-model.help: Checks finished work until it passes or is truly stuck.

ai.models.goal-verifier-model.label: Goals: checking the work
ai.models.goal-verifier-model.help: Checks Goal results. Kept apart from the worker.

ai.models.subagent-model.label: Helper agents
ai.models.subagent-model.help: Never bigger than the agent that started it.

ai.models.teach-model.label: Explaining things to you
ai.models.teach-model.help: Answers "explain this to me". A cheaper model is fine.

ai.models.thread-title-model.label: Naming chats
ai.models.thread-title-model.help: Renaming a chat yourself keeps your name.

ai.models.custom-variants.label: Your own presets
ai.models.custom-variants.help: Each has a name, a model, and an optional note.

ai.models.disable-builtin-variant.label: Hide the built-in presets
ai.models.disable-builtin-variant.help: Only your own presets show in pickers.

ai.models.model-alias.label: Model nicknames
ai.models.model-alias.help: Pickers find a model by its nickname first.

ai.models.synthetic-continue-attempts.label: Nudges to finish a cut-off answer

ai.models.switch-sanitization.label: Tidy up when the model changes

ai.accounts.multi-account-switching.label: Switch accounts by themselves
ai.accounts.multi-account-switching.help: When one account hits its limit, the next one carries on.

ai.accounts.soft-switch.label: Switch at a natural break
ai.accounts.soft-switch.help: Moves between tasks when quota runs low, not in the middle of one.

ai.accounts.soft-warning-level.label: Warn when this much is left
ai.accounts.soft-warning-level.help: A heads-up before an account runs low.

ai.accounts.hard-switch-level.label: Switch when this much is left
ai.accounts.hard-switch-level.help: Below this, work moves to the next account.

ai.accounts.default-account.label: Which account goes first

options.Pick per provider: The one I pick for each service

ai.accounts.default-account.help: Each service's account list is in its page under Services.

ai.accounts.account-binding.label: Stick to a chosen account
ai.accounts.account-binding.help: Whether work may use a different account than the one you chose.

ai.models.provider-fallback.label: Move to another service when one is down
ai.models.provider-fallback.help: Otherwise the run stops when its service is down.

ai.models.provider-priority.label: Service try order
ai.models.provider-priority.help: Used when several services could do a job.

ai.models.resolution-policy.label: How boldly to pick models
ai.models.resolution-policy.help: Careful never guesses; bold chases the cheapest or fastest.

ai.usage.auto-resume-default.label: Pick up paused work when usage resets
ai.usage.auto-resume-default.help: Work you paused yourself always stays paused.

ai.usage.monthly-spend-limit.label: Monthly spending limit
ai.usage.monthly-spend-limit.help: What happens at the limit is set below.

ai.usage.monthly-token-budget.label: Monthly token budget
ai.usage.monthly-token-budget.help: Feeds the warnings and run limits.

ai.usage.budget-policy.label: At the limit
ai.usage.budget-policy.help: Stopping is safest for your wallet.

ai.usage.budget-warning-threshold.label: Warn at
ai.usage.budget-warning-threshold.help: Share of a limit used before you are warned.

ai.usage.pressure-visibility.label: Warn before limits
ai.usage.pressure-visibility.help: Small warnings when accounts get close to a limit.

ai.usage.cooldown-timers.label: Show resting accounts
ai.usage.cooldown-timers.help: In pickers and on the Usage page.

ai.usage.usage-windows.label: Time windows shown
ai.usage.usage-windows.help: The 5-hour and 7-day windows match most plans.

ai.usage.platform-filters.label: Services on the Usage page
ai.usage.platform-filters.help: Hiding one does not stop tracking it.

ai.usage.tool-usage-window.label: Tool statistics window
ai.usage.tool-usage-window.help: For the tool statistics on the Usage page.

ai.usage.ledger-export.label: Export format
ai.usage.ledger-export.help: CSV opens in spreadsheets; JSON suits other tools.
